run_live_check_loop: run the async live_check_loop to monitor request activity and self-terminate the worker after idle timeout
use_request_witnesses_context_manager: use the request_witnesses context manager to track request start and end timestamps for idle monitoring
configure_idle_timeout: configure the IDLE_TIMEOUT environment variable to set how long the worker waits before self-terminating
enable_unload_idle: enable the UNLOAD_IDLE environment variable to activate idle worker unloading behavior
review_live_check_loop: review the live_check_loop function to understand how it checks LAST_START and LAST_END timestamps before sending SIGTERM
